title: The roster at a glance
summary: Puts staffing and team assignments where nurses can find them during a shift.
changes: Changes puts absence, overtime, cover, sharing and Activity on one page.
Add absence and Add overtime are always visible at the top of the staffing list, and both forms show the selected date.
Night brings personal duty, break and colleague together above compact team assignments. The live shift timeline and clock-change details stay visible.
The main roster tabs reopen at the top, and the guide reflects the shorter workflow.
